title: VDBE expanded-SQL host-parameter token scan

scope.rationale: findNextHostParameter is the tokenizer-backed boundary that finds the next bind parameter without mistaking quoted text, identifiers, or comments for variables, and sqlite3_expanded_sql uses that scan to return caller-owned SQL with bound values expanded.

external_source_responsibilities: Source-faithful sqlite3GetToken implementation and generated TK_VARIABLE/TK_ILLEGAL codes
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete private scan body and public sqlite3_expanded_sql null/saved-SQL allocation owner are assigned and integrated. Nested-execution formatting remains separately owned.

inputs: NUL-terminated UTF-8 SQL at a token boundary and writable token-length output
outputs: Byte count before the next TK_VARIABLE and that variable token length, or total remaining byte count and zero token length
contracts.ownership: SQL is borrowed and never mutated; token-length output is overwritten on every call.
contracts.state_and_results: Every non-variable token contributes its exact tokenizer length. Scanning stops before the first variable token. Valid prepared SQL cannot produce zero-length or illegal tokens.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, allocation, or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: The source contract asserts token validity. Empty input returns zero prefix and zero token length.

representation_differences: Source i64 byte counts are represented as usize because the native caller scans an in-memory Zig sentinel slice; the profile cannot construct a slice beyond addressable memory.
The Zig tokenizer returns a typed Result instead of writing token type through an integer pointer.

oracle.protocol: A native unit trace scans SQL containing variables after quoted strings and block comments, scans a following numbered variable, and scans SQL with no variables; compare prefix and token lengths exactly. Public expanded-SQL tests exercise bound substitution through this owner.
oracle.normalization: Pointer addresses are not compared; UTF-8 byte offsets and token lengths are exact. Pinned-C isolated scan trace remains pending.

assurance.oom: The scan allocates nothing; caller accumulation OOM remains caller-owned.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or mutable shared state.
assurance.malformed_input: Like source, illegal tokens violate the prepared-SQL precondition and assert in safety builds.
assurance.continuation: Each call starts from caller-provided SQL and resets token length before scanning.
assurance.performance: Linear in bytes before the next variable and performs one tokenizer pass.

integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_expanded_sql calls expandedSql, which repeatedly calls findNextHostParameter before resolving and rendering each binding.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The bespoke quote/comment/variable scanner in expandedSql was removed; token boundary ownership now resides here.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C isolated scan trace, expanded-SQL assurance closure, and independent review.
